label: Espruino Pico
description: Espruino is an Interactive JavaScript interpreter for Microcontrollers, so you can program them quickly and easily. The Espruino Pico is a specially designed board with Espruino software pre-installed. It complements the Espruino software with masses of functionality and great battery life.
